bio: Restaurateur Björn Swanson, known on the Berlin food scene from faelt in the Schöneberg neighbourhood, brings his sophisticated yet accessible dining concept to SWAN&SON – a modern bistro tale. Indeed, his dishes are modern and creative, combining classic and Japanese influences: think black cod with sesame, spinach & soy beurre blanc or cordon bleu {tonkatsu style} with shiitake cream & cucumber salad. The space is all clean-lined chic; the terrace in front of the restaurant is lovely. At lunchtime, there is a somewhat simpler and more affordable offering....
